intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — check you are in a test copy. Look for the small “🧪 Test copy” mark on the screen. It means this app has never seen you, which is what the steps below expect. If it is missing and the app already shows your own information, you have opened your real app: go back to your list and tap this app's name again, rather than using a bookmark, your history, or an icon on your home screen. Starting in the wrong copy makes the early steps look broken when nothing is wrong.

You will peek at the example business (Miller Plumbing), then set the app up for a pretend builder, Miller Construction, using the General Construction price list. You add a customer (Linda Hansen), price a garage-framing job, mark it approved, take a deposit, record a lumber bill, add to-dos and tax dates, and check everything is still there after a reload. Never press a 📨 Send or 📞 Call button — they would reach a real person. The last two steps DO ask you to open 💬 Message and tap WhatsApp: that is safe, because you choose no chat and press no send.

🔁 If you have tested Business Manager before on this phone, erase its data before step 1: the round “?” in the bottom corner → “🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data” → OK → OK. The setup only fills the price list when it is empty, so otherwise your old prices stay and several steps will not match. A short setup may be offered after the welcome tour, four questions you answer by tapping. Unless a step tells you to try it, tap “No thanks, just open it”.

steps.do: When the app opens, a “Welcome to Business Manager” card is at the bottom. Tap the small link “skip the tour” at its bottom-right.
steps.see: The card asks “How do you want to start?” with “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” (it mentions Miller Plumbing) and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A green greeting may show at the top for a few seconds — it goes away by itself. A purple “Test copy” pill means you are in a safe test copy.

steps.do: Tap “🧪 Keep the examples to play with”.
steps.see: An example business opens: “Miller Plumbing & Repair” at the top, a note “This is an example business. Play with anything.”, then a card “☀️ Your day” (or “🌙 Evening wrap-up” after 3pm) with Morning and Evening buttons, three buttons “⏱ Running late”, “🚚 On my way”, “✅ Done, bill it”, a money card showing Owed to me $175 · 1 late, and further down a “NEEDS YOU (6)” list that starts “Mike Peterson — $175.00 is 6 days late”.
steps.tip: Look around if you like, but do not press “Remind”, “Send”, “Check in” or the three text buttons yet — they open a text message. You will try them later, on your own business.

steps.do: Scroll to the top and tap “Start my own business” in the example note. On the next screen, tap “Next →” without typing anything.
steps.see: A “Set up · about two minutes” chat asks “First: what’s your business called, and what’s your name?” with two boxes. Tapping Next with them empty shows a box: “What’s the business called? (Your own name is fine.)” — tap OK and you stay on the question.
steps.tip: 🔁 TESTED THIS APP BEFORE? Erase it first, or steps 9, 10, 13 and 14 will not match. Tap the round “?” in the bottom corner → “🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data” → OK → OK. The setup only fills the price list when it is EMPTY, so on a second run your old prices stay and the nine construction prices this script needs are never put in. Frank hit this on 9 November: his list had 10 items and no Framing row, so steps 9 and 10 could not work. That was our mistake, not his.

steps.do: Type the business name in the first box and your name in the second box (both below), then tap “Next →”.
steps.see: It asks “What do you need, Dave?” with “🧾 Just quotes (Quick Quote)” and “🧰 The whole business” — the second one already shows “✓ Picked”.
steps.tip: If you leave the app halfway through the setup and come back, tap “Set it up for my business” again: since v1.6 (11 November) your answers are kept and it carries on where you stopped. Before that, leaving the app lost them. Frank found this on 11 November.

steps.do: Tap “🧰 The whole business”.
steps.see: “Good to meet you, Dave. What kind of work do you do?” with 12 buttons, including “🏗️ General Construction”.

steps.do: Tap “🏗️ General Construction”.
steps.see: “How should customers reach you? This goes on your estimates and invoices.” with Phone, Email and Business address (optional).
steps.tip: Your button may read “🏗️ Building & Construction” (the Kenya edition) — tap that one. Same job, different name.

steps.do: Type the phone and email below into the first two boxes and tap “Next →”.
steps.see: Your answer shows as a bubble, and the next question is “Before you start a job, do customers usually get a price in writing?” with three answers.

steps.do: Instead of answering the rest, tap “Skip — turn everything on” at the bottom-right. Read the list, then tap “Let’s go →”.
steps.see: “All set, Dave. Here’s what I turned on for you:” — Estimates, Itemized prices, Deposits & progress billing, Schedule, Job costs, Crew & hours, Expenses & profit, To-do & due dates, Invoices with a Pay now link — and “I started your price list with typical general construction prices.” After Let’s go: “Miller Construction” at the top, “Good afternoon, Dave.”, Owed to me $0 and “✅ All caught up. Nice work.”
steps.tip: A short tip “Tip: tap + to add your first job” shows at the bottom for a moment.

steps.do: Tap ⚙️ More (bottom-right), then “🏷 Price list” (it says 9 items).
steps.see: Nine rows with a price each: Project supervision (per day) 650, Labor crew (per hour) 85, Framing (per sq ft) 9, Concrete (per cu yd) 240, Drywall (per sq ft) 3.5, Permit & inspection fees 0, Materials (at cost) 0, Dumpster / haul-away 550, Equipment rental (per day) 325.
steps.tip: In the test copy the round ? button sits over the right half of ⚙️ More. If a Help sheet opens instead, close it and tap the left edge of More, just left of the gear. Does it say a different number of items, or is there no Framing row? Then this app still has your list from a previous run. Go back to the top of this script and do the erase in step 3's tip first. The item names are cut off on a small phone — tap a name box and move along it to read the rest.

steps.do: Find the row that starts “Framing (per sq ft)”. It has two boxes and a red ✕: the wide box on the left is the name, the small box on the right that says 9 is the price. Tap that small box, delete the 9 and type the number below, then tap on the empty area above the list.
steps.see: A green “Saved ✓” pill shows briefly. The Framing row’s price box now says 10.
steps.tip: Faith asked on 14 November where the price is in that row — the step now says. Do not touch the ✕: it removes the whole row. Kenya edition: your price list has different rows (Site supervision, Fundi labour…) and no Framing row. Change the price box of the FIRST row instead, and say in your note which row you used. Do not touch the ✕.

steps.do: Tap the round yellow “+ New” at the bottom, then “👤 New customer”. Type the name, phone and address below (leave Email empty) and tap “Save customer”.
steps.type: Linda Hansen · 847-555-0142 · 1420 Ridge Rd, Gurnee, IL
steps.see: Linda Hansen’s page: her phone and address, buttons 📞 Call, 💬 Message, 📍 Map, “Paid you, all time $0.00”, “No jobs yet.” and “➕ New job for Linda”.
steps.tip: Do not press Call or Message — they open your real phone.

steps.do: Tap “➕ New job for Linda”. The Customer box already says Linda Hansen. In “What’s the job?” type the first part below, in Details type the second part, then tap “Save job →”.
steps.type: Garage framing · 20x20 detached garage. Frame walls and roof, about 400 sq ft.
steps.see: The job page: “Garage framing” with “#1001 · Linda Hansen”, a “New” label, your details, and under PRICE / ESTIMATE “No price yet.” with “⚡ Draft from my price list”, “➕ Add item” and Total $0.00.
steps.tip: Do not press “📨 Send the estimate” or “📨 Send estimate”.

steps.do: Tap “⚡ Draft from my price list”.
steps.see: Two lines appear, each marked “📌 price list”: Framing (per sq ft) $10.00 and Drywall hang & finish (per sq ft) $3.50. Total $13.50. Note: the draft puts 1 of each — it does not pick up the “400 sq ft” from your details, and it added drywall you did not ask for.

steps.do: Tap the Drywall line and tap “Remove”. Then tap the Framing line, change “How many” to the number below and tap “Save”. Then tap “➕ Add item”, tap “Dumpster / haul-away $550.00” and tap “Save”.
steps.see: Framing shows “400 × $10.00” and $4,000.00; Dumpster / haul-away shows $550.00; Total $4,550.00.

steps.do: Scroll down a little and tap “👍 They said yes”. The box already says Linda Hansen and today’s date — tap “Mark approved”.
steps.see: A note “Approved. Next: pick a day.”, the label at the top now says Approved, and the estimate shows “✅ Approved by Linda Hansen on” today’s date.

steps.do: Scroll down to BILLING (Job total $4,550.00) and tap “Deposit (30%)”.
steps.see: “Invoice #2001” for Linda Hansen: $1,365.00, “still owed · Deposit”, “Not sent”, and one line “Deposit — 30% of Garage framing ($4,550.00)”.
steps.tip: Do not press “📨 Send invoice with pay link”.

steps.do: Tap “💵 Record a payment”. The amount already says 1365.00. Change “How” to Check and tap “Save payment”.
steps.see: A note “Deposit received 👍”; the invoice says “paid in full · Deposit”, Balance due $0.00, and under PAYMENTS: today, Check, $1,365.00.

steps.do: Tap 💵 Money at the bottom. Then tap “➕ Expense”, type the amount and the store below, choose the job “Garage framing — Linda Hansen” under “For a job?”, and tap “Save”.
steps.see: Before: Money in $1,365.00, Profit $1,365.00. As you type Menards the kind changes to “Materials & supplies” by itself. After saving: Money out −$1,200.00, Profit $165.00, “Set aside about $41 for income tax”, and under JOB BY JOB: Garage framing, $3,350, 74% kept.

steps.do: Tap 🏠 Today, then “📝 To-do”. Type the to-do below, pick a date 3 days from today, tap “Add”. Then tap “📋 Add common due dates — taxes, truck, insurance” and “Add the ticked ones”. Finally tap the round ○ next to the trusses to-do.
steps.type: Order roof trusses for Hansen garage
steps.see: First “THIS WEEK (1) · Order roof trusses for Hansen garage · Due in 3 days”. Then “Added 7 due dates”, including Payroll taxes (Form 941), Quarterly estimated taxes (IRS 1040-ES) and File income taxes (Schedule C), each with its next due date (the dates move with today’s date). Tapping ○ shows “Done ✓” and the trusses move to “DONE LATELY”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload. If a “What would you like to do?” page shows, tap “Pick up where I left off”. Tap 🏠 Today, then 🧰 Jobs.
steps.see: Everything is kept: Today shows “Miller Construction” at the top and the money card says Money in $1,365; Jobs shows “Garage framing · Linda Hansen · $4,550 · Approved”, and the to-do list still has the tax dates.

steps.do: Tap “⚙️ More” at the bottom, then “👥 Customers”, then “Linda Hansen”. On her page tap “💬 Message”.
steps.see: A message box opens with words already written to Linda. Under it: “📨 Text it”, then “💬 WhatsApp”, then a 📋 copy button (it says “Share / copy” on most phones and just “Copy” on some). There is no Email button, because Linda’s email was left empty.
steps.tip: The 💬 emoji moved from Text it to WhatsApp — Text it is now 📨. The small print under the row should mention WhatsApp.

steps.do: Tap “💬 WhatsApp”.
steps.see: WhatsApp opens with the message to Linda already typed in, and asks which chat to send it to. Pick nothing and come back. Close the message box, tap ⚙️ More and scroll to the very bottom: it says “Business Manager v2.3.1 · 2026-11-23”. Next, the cash look-ahead.
steps.tip: If WhatsApp is not on this phone, a WhatsApp web page opens instead and asks you to install it — that still counts as working. A US number saved without a country code cannot be dialled straight into WhatsApp, so it asks you which chat — that is expected.

steps.do: Tap 🧰 Jobs at the bottom, then “Garage framing”. Scroll down to BILLING and tap “🧾 Final invoice ($3,185.00)”.
steps.see: “Invoice #2002” for Linda Hansen: $3,185.00 still owed, “Not sent”. (That is the job total, less the deposit Linda already paid.)

steps.do: Tap 💵 Money at the bottom, then the card “📅 Next 30 / 60 days” near the top.
steps.see: A page called “Next 30 / 60 days” with a box “💰 Cash in the bank today” and a yellow note asking you to type it in. Under NEXT 30 DAYS: Coming in +$3,185, Going out −$0, and a card for Linda Hansen, Invoice #2002, due two weeks from today, “not sent yet”. Under BILLS THAT REPEAT it says “None yet.”

steps.do: Tap the “Cash in the bank today” box, type the number below, then tap on an empty part of the page.
steps.see: Two big green numbers appear: “In 30 days $5,685” and “In 60 days $5,685”, each with the date under it. ($2,500 in the bank plus Linda’s $3,185.)

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “➕ Add a bill”. Tap the “Truck payment” button at the top. “How often?” already says Every month. Type the amount and the day below into “Amount each time” and “Day of the month”, and tap “Save”.
steps.see: Under BILLS THAT REPEAT: “🔁 Truck payment ⚠️ · On the 5th of each month · $650” (the ⚠️ means you’ll be warned about it on Today). Each truck payment now shows as −$650 under NEXT 30 DAYS and DAYS 31 TO 60, and each one takes $650 off the big numbers. On most dates there is one in each, so the big numbers read $5,035 and $4,385.

steps.do: Tap the “🔁 Truck payment” card under BILLS THAT REPEAT, then tap “Delete” and OK.
steps.see: It asks “Delete this bill?”. After OK the list says “None yet.” again and both big numbers are back to $5,685.

steps.do: Tap 🧰 Jobs at the bottom, then “Garage framing”, then “✏️ Edit”. Set Day to today and Time to about an hour from now. In “What to bring” type the words below. Tap “Save”.
steps.see: The job page again, now showing today’s date and the time you picked. (If it is after 10pm where you are, pick a time before midnight instead.)

steps.do: Tap 🏠 Today at the bottom. If the card at the top says “🌙 Evening wrap-up”, tap “Morning” on it.
steps.see: A card “☀️ Your day” with short sentences: “1 job today. First:” your time, “Garage framing for Linda Hansen, 1420 Ridge Rd, Gurnee, IL”, then “Bring for Linda Hansen: the framing nailer.”, “Nobody owes you money right now.” (Linda’s final invoice was never sent, so it does not count yet), a “Due today:” line or “Nothing else is due today.”, and usually a line saying which day this week is open.

steps.do: Turn your sound on and tap “🔊 Read it to me” on that card.
steps.see: The phone reads the card out loud, the same words in the same order.
steps.tip: If nothing is heard, check the phone is not on silent. Say so in your report if it still stays quiet: which phone, and which browser.

steps.do: Tap “⏱ Running late”. If the phone asks to use your location, tap “Don’t allow”. Then tap “30 min”.
steps.see: A box “⏱ Running late · Linda Hansen” that says “Location is off, so pick how long you’ll be.”, buttons from 10 to 60 min, and a text that changes when you tap 30 min: “Hi Linda, I’m running a little behind. Sorry about that. See you around” a time 30 minutes from now, signed with your name and business. At the bottom: “Your location is only read now, on this phone… never saved or sent.”
steps.tip: If you tap Allow instead, it says roughly how many minutes away Linda’s address is. That is fine too — say which you saw.

steps.do: Tap “Next: check it and send →”. Read the box, then use your phone’s Back (or tap “← Back” at the top of the box).
steps.see: The usual message box, with the same words already written and buttons 📨 Text it, 💬 WhatsApp and 📋 copy. Back takes you to the Running late box again, with your 30 min still picked; Back once more closes it. Nothing was sent, and you are still in the app.

steps.do: Tap “✅ Done, bill it”, then the 📋 copy button (“Share / copy” or “Copy”). If a share menu opens, close it.
steps.see: First a message: “Hi Linda, all done at your place today. Thanks for having me! Your invoice is on its way.” After the copy button, the Garage framing job page opens and its label says “Done — bill it”.

steps.do: Tap 🏠 Today, then “Evening” on the top card.
steps.see: “🌙 Evening wrap-up”: “Today: $1,365 came in and $1,200 went out, so you made $165.”, “Every finished job has been billed.” (the deposit and the final invoice together cover the whole $4,550), and “Nothing booked for tomorrow yet.”

steps.do: Under the three text buttons is a money card headed “Today”. Swipe it to the left, three times.
steps.see: Today: Money in $1,365, Money out −$1,200, Profit $165, Owed to me $0, Bills still to pay $0. Each swipe shows the next card: “This week”, then this month (“Nov so far”), then the year (“2026 so far”). Money in and Money out are at least as big on each one as on the card before.

steps.do: Tap 🏠 Today, then the big “🎤 Tap and talk” button (under the three text buttons) once. Then tap the 🎤 on your keyboard (on a computer, just type), say the words below, and tap Done.
steps.see: A box “🎤 Say it, or type it” opens with the keyboard already up and one short line: “Use the 🎤 on your keyboard. More than one? Say “another receipt”.” Your words appear under “What you said” as you talk. Then: 🧾 Receipt is picked, Amount says 45, Store says Menards, and “For which job?” says Garage framing — Linda Hansen. Nothing is saved yet. To add more, tap “🎤 Add more with your keyboard’s mic” and use the keyboard’s 🎤 again — the new words go on the end.
steps.tip: Open the test in Safari (or Chrome on Android), not inside another app: if the page has an X at the top and a compass at the bottom, tap the compass first. The first time, allow the microphone. To add more, tap 🎤 Tap and talk in the box again; what you say is added to the end. If a note says the microphone can't be used here, use the 🎤 on your keyboard instead and say so in your report.

steps.do: Tap “📸 Add the photo” and take a picture of any piece of paper. Then tap “Save it”.
steps.see: The photo button changes to “Photo added ✓”. After Save it, a note says “Saved $45.00 → Garage framing”, and on the money card, Today’s Money out goes from −$1,200 to −$1,245 and Profit from $165 to $120. Under 💵 Money → 🗂️ Receipts there is now a Menards receipt for $45.00 with a 📸 next to it.

steps.do: Back on 🏠 Today, tap “🎤 Tap and talk”, then the 🎤 on your keyboard, say the words below, tap Done, then tap “Save it”.
steps.type: Quote the Garcias: replace kitchen faucet, 2 hours
steps.see: Before saving, 📝 Quote is picked, Customer says Garcia and The work says “replace kitchen faucet, 2 hours”. After Save it, a note says “Draft estimate for Garcia is waiting in Needs you”, and under NEEDS YOU there is “📝 Draft estimate ready for Garcia · Replace kitchen faucet · you said it”. Tap it: a new job “Replace kitchen faucet” for Garcia, already priced from your price list (Labor crew (per hour), 2 × $85.00 = $170.00).

steps.do: Tap 💵 Money, then “📅 Next 30 / 60 days”, then “➕ Add a bill”. Tap the “Truck insurance” button at the top. Set “How often?” to Once a year, type the amount below, and set “Next due” to 10 days from today. Leave “⚠️ Warn me on Today before it’s due” ticked, and tap “Save”.
steps.see: When you pick Once a year, “Day of the month” changes to “Next due”, and the ⚠️ box is ticked by itself. After Save, under BILLS THAT REPEAT: “🔁 Truck insurance ⚠️ · Once a year · next” your date, and $1,140. It also shows as −$1,140 under NEXT 30 DAYS.

steps.do: Tap 🏠 Today and look under the three text buttons.
steps.see: A yellow card “⚠️ Worth knowing” with “💳 Truck insurance $1,140 is due” your date “(in 10 days).”, and two buttons: “See bills” and “Got it”. It may also list other things that matter (an estimate waiting a week, work done but not billed); each has its own buttons. The money card underneath shows $1,140 under “Bills still to pay” on the year card (swipe to the last card).

steps.do: Tap “Got it” next to the truck insurance line. Then pull the page down to reload it.
steps.see: The truck insurance line goes away and stays away after the reload. If it was the only line, the whole yellow card goes. It comes back by itself next year, when the next due date is different.

steps.do: Tap 💵 Money, then “➕ Expense”. Tap in the “Where / what” box, use the 🎤 on your keyboard and say “Menards lumber”, then tap Done. Tap in the “Note” box and do the same with “for the deck”. Then tap back in “Where / what” and add “and screws” the same way.
steps.see: No round 🎤 button pops up beside any box you tap. Only the keyboard’s own 🎤 is used, and all three times your words go in. This is the same everywhere in the app, including the box “🎤 Tap and talk” opens. Close the box without saving.

steps.do: Back on 🏠 Today, tap “🎤 Tap and talk”, then the 🎤 on your keyboard, and say the words below in one go. Tap Done, check the first receipt, then tap “Save it”.
steps.type: Receipt, 12 dollars Home Depot, another receipt thirty-two ninety-five Menards
steps.see: First box: 🧾 Receipt, Amount 12, Store Home Depot, a yellow line “➡️ One more receipt is waiting…”, and the button says “Save it — then the next receipt ➡️”. After you tap it, the next box opens by itself with “Receipt thirty-two ninety-five Menards” (or 3295) in it, Store Menards, and two buttons under Amount: “$32.95” and “$3,295”. Save it won’t go until you tap one. Tap $32.95, then Save it. Both receipts are now under 💵 Money → 🗂️ Receipts.

steps.do: Now the videos. This app has 3. Open each one and watch it right through, sound on: Explain it to me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=businessmanager&mode=firsttime  Watch it work — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=businessmanager  Train me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=businessmanager&mode=train
steps.see: Each one talks without stopping — no long silences, no sentence starting again. The screen behind the words changes to match what is being said, and when it points at something, that thing is really there. If a video talks about a button or a screen you did not see in this app, say so — that is a real fault and one of the most useful things you can find.

steps.do: Last, the shop page everyone sees before they buy: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/ — find this app on its shelf and read its card.
steps.see: The name and the one-line description match the app you just used. The price says Free, with an optional donation to Loving InDeed. That is right: nothing is sold, and nobody has to give. Nothing on the card promises something the app does not do. If the card and the app disagree, the card is the fault — say which bit.

steps.do: Tap the ? button at the top right, then tap “Make it mine”. If it shows “Set it up now”, tap that and answer the four questions by tapping. (If you already answered them when the app first opened, tap “Answer them again”.)
steps.see: Four questions, one at a time, each answered with one tap. At the end it says “Done — that is yours now”. Say whether the questions made sense for this app, and whether any answer you wanted was missing.

steps.do: Tap ? then “Make it mine” again, then tap “✨ Make it mine — ask for something”. Ask for one report you would really want from this app, in your own words. Answer its questions.
steps.see: It asks you a few short questions, then builds a report. Tell us: did the questions make sense, and is the report something you would actually use? If it cannot make one, write down exactly what it said.
